domestic_evidence: No domestic-supply record could be retrieved: web_search backend returned 'no results (searx: <urlopen error [Errno 111] Connection refused>)' on both attempts, so GeM/CPPP tender pages and the annual report could not be located; tenderdetail.com company page returned HTTP 404. note: Legal entity exists and is active in customs data: HLL Lifecare Limited (formerly Hindustan Latex Ltd), Poojappura, Thiruvananthapuram, Kerala — a Government of India enterprise. Export shipments are factually confirmed by dated customs/B-L records, not by website claims: condoms (HS 40141010) to Oman and Italy, blood collection bags (HS 90189032) to Nepal Red Cross, dataloggers to UNFPA Paraguay, plus institutional buyers in Nauru, Botswana and UAE. Declared HS 300450 (pharmaceutical preparations) does not match the observed codes — actual exports are HS 40141010 (condoms), 90189032 (medical/surgical instruments) and 90258010 (measuring instruments); per project rules this is not a rejection ground, the code should be corrected to the factual range and the verdict treated as accepted_hs_corrected. Note the industry label 'Нефтегаз и химия' is also inaccurate — the company is a latex/medical-devices and healthcare-products manufacturer (manufacturer role, not trader). Domestic supply status left as unknown rather than declared_only because the search tool was down and no GST/tender evidence could be read at all; this is a data gap, not a negative finding. No CIN/PAN quoted as none was verified in the reachable sources.
